Spatial Video-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Stereoscopic spatial-video listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Spatial Video feature — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Spatial Video phrasing

US pages use "Spatial Video", "Spatial Video capture", "Stereoscopic video", "Immersive spatial recording", "Record for Apple Vision Pro", or "Relive moments in spatial video." Apple's Simplified Chinese Camera vocabulary often uses 空间视频 for the general spatial-video label, 空间视频拍摄 for capture-mode marketing, and 空间影片 for the spatial video output buyers replay on Apple Vision Pro. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing spatial capture capabilities your app does not support.

Device compatibility vs playback destination

Spatial Video marketing often shows two beats — capture on iPhone 15 Pro (or compatible devices) and replay on Apple Vision Pro. Chinese buyers expect per-frame captions: iPhone 上拍摄空间视频 for capture demos, 在 Apple Vision Pro 上重温 for playback frames — not one generic "强大相机" string on every frame.

Depth and immersion without overclaiming

Spatial Video promises depth-rich immersive replay — not generic 4K or HDR badges alone. zh-Hans overlays should name the spatial outcome the frame shows: 立体空间视频 for stereoscopic capture, 沉浸式空间录制 for recording demos, 空间深度 for depth-rich playback — not English "3D video" pasted through machine translation without Apple-aligned context.

Do not conflate with Spatial Audio or Cinematic Mode

Spatial Video captures stereoscopic footage for Vision Pro replay. Spatial Audio positions sound in headphone space — 空间音频 belongs on audio frames, not spatial video capture. Cinematic Mode adds shallow-depth rack focus to flat video — 电影效果 belongs on cinematic blur frames, not spatial recording. If your app supports multiple Camera surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

iPhone Camera Spatial Video capture marketing belongs on the main iOS product page. Apple Vision Pro app name, subtitle, and spatial screenshot galleries on the visionOS tab are a separate scope — see visionOS listing (zh-Hans) when your gap is headset store metadata, not iPhone spatial capture.
